title: The Borrowed Lantern
author: Dominic Crane
blurb: Ulyana Eastwick, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
